parameters.name: Ids
parameters.description: The IDs of the configuration sets. Separate multiple IDs with commas. This parameter is required.

parameters.name: IsForce
parameters.description: Specifies whether to force delete the associations with sender addresses.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dm config-set-delete --ids xxx --is-force true --api-version 2015-11-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dm ConfigSetDelete --region cn-hangzhou --IsForce true --Ids xxx
